name: RC-B10-0324/2025/REV1 – After § 13 – Am 8
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
part_text: 13a. Insists that any external sourcing of raw materials must adhere to the highest international social, environmental and governance standards and calls for strategic partnerships on raw materials to include clear, specific and binding measures for mandatory due diligence on the environmental, social and human rights impact for companies involved in the supply chain;
